title: Calculate Digit Sum of a String
goal: Repeatedly replace groups of k digits by their digit sums until the string is short enough.
strategy: Read each round from an unchanged source string. Each group sum may have more than one digit, so concatenate decimal sums before deciding whether another round is needed.
